categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily manufactures household sewing machines, sewing machine parts and components, aluminum alloy die-casting, vacuum cleaners, and vacuum cleaner components for domestic and international markets. It also engages in general import-export trade and acts as an agent for related products. Additionally, through its subsidiary, it processes and manufactures precision metal parts for automotive, medical, industrial, and bicycle industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced mechanical and electronic integration technologies, including microcomputer and stepper motor-driven computerized sewing machines. It employs vertical integration in early production stages, modular design, 3D design software, PLM systems, and manufacturing execution systems (MES/SPC) to enhance production efficiency and quality. The company also emphasizes automation, quality control, and environmental management systems such as ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include global well-known household sewing machine brands, mainly in advanced economies such as the United States, Japan, Germany, and Europe. The company serves ODM clients and maintains long-term partnerships with major international brands. Emerging markets like China, Russia, Eastern Europe, Middle East, India, and South America are also targeted for low-priced machine demand growth.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates manufacturing bases in Taiwan, China, and Vietnam, with sales primarily focused on export markets including the United States, Germany, Turkey, Taiwan, Russia, India, and other countries worldwide. It maintains a global marketing network and participates in international trade shows in Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and assembly of household sewing machines and related products. It maintains close relationships with upstream suppliers of raw materials and components, ensuring stable supply and cost control. It also provides after-sales technical support and training to downstream customers and distributors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continuous R&D investment to develop new products and technologies, especially computerized sewing machines with enhanced functions and connectivity. The company emphasizes product line expansion, modular design, quality improvement, green product management, and compliance with environmental regulations. It also focuses on talent development, digital transformation, and expanding market presence in emerging regions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of household sewing machines, vacuum cleaners, and precision metal parts. The company operates mainly on an ODM and OEM basis for global brand clients. It also earns income from related services such as technical training, after-sales support, and export trading activities.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include Japanese brands such as JANOME, BROTHER, HAPPY, and BERNINA, as well as other Taiwanese and Chinese manufacturers. The company positions itself as a leading Taiwanese ODM manufacturer with a comprehensive product line, strong R&D capabilities, and long-term partnerships with global brands. It competes on quality, technology integration, and cost efficiency.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$8.34 billion in the latest fiscal year, representing a 10.31% increase from the prior year. Pre-tax net profit rose by about 71%, with earnings per share increasing to NT$6.81. The company maintains a stable financial structure with steady growth in assets and equity, supported by ongoing investments in R&D and production capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers a broad and complete product line of household sewing machines ranging from mechanical to high-end computerized embroidery models, emphasizing quality, functionality, and price competitiveness. Its strong ODM customization capabilities, integration of advanced microcomputer and mechatronic technologies, and commitment to green manufacturing and customer service differentiate it in the global market. Long-term partnerships and stable supply chain relationships further enhance its value proposition.
